decision.explanation: Document d2 explicitly states Claudio Muccioli was sworn in as Captain Regent of San Marino and previously served as a member of the Grand and General Council; Document d1 contains a fictional narrative claiming he is also Archbishop of Tarragona, which contradicts real-world facts and is treated as a story element rather than verified evidence.
